# Shapes Catalog

| Id         | Description                                                                               |
| ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `circle`   | Circular silhouette centered at the origin with radius r (meters).                        |
| `ellipse`  | Elliptical silhouette centered at the origin with width w and height h (meters).          |
| `rect`     | Axis-aligned rectangle with optional rounded corners (dimensions in meters).              |
| `capsule`  | Horizontal stadium/capsule along local X with segment length and end radius (meters).     |
| `triangle` | Isosceles triangle pointing along +X with length w and base width h (meters).             |
| `polygon`  | Regular convex polygon with N sides (>= 3) and circumradius r (meters).                   |
| `convex`   | Polygon defined by arbitrary vertices (meters); non-convex inputs follow ConcaveStrategy. |
